name: What alternatives are there to widening a hallway for better flow?

mainEntity.name: What alternatives are there to widening a hallway for better flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: If structural widening isn't feasible or desired, alternatives exist to improve hallway flow and perception of space. These include strategic lighting to brighten and expand the feel of the area, using lighter paint colors, installing flush-mount doors instead of standard swinging doors, or incorporating built-in shelving to free up floor space. Removing bulky furniture or decor can also make a significant difference in perceived clearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Alternatives to widening include strategic lighting, lighter paint colors, flush-mount doors, built-in shelving, and removing bulky decor.
